currentCard.prompt: С какой функцией прежде всего связывают область Брока в доминантном полушарии мозга?

answers.note: Мозжечок сравнивает двигательные команды с обратной связью от мышц и суставов, включая ощущения равновесия.
В задней части веретенообразной извилины есть участок коры, избирательно реагирующий на лица.
Область Брока связана с контролем движений, необходимых для речи.

currentCard.explanation: Область Брока связана с продукцией языка и контролем движений, необходимых для речи. У большинства людей она расположена в левом полушарии.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: The Central Nervous System

literal.prompt: С какой функцией прежде всего связывают область Брока в доминантном полушарии мозга?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: OpenStax L54 assigns Broca language production and control of speech movements. L79–L83 explain predominant language lateralisation without exclusive ownership by one hemisphere; “прежде всего” and “доминантном” preserve the functional-localisation scope. Balance belongs to cerebellar comparison/correction (L116–L121); visual processing is occipital/temporal/parietal (L48); the primary face study identifies posterior fusiform face-selective cortex (PMC L112–L114). Thus speech production is the sole primary Broca association among four comparable neurological functions.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Область Брока связана с продукцией языка и контролем движений, необходимых для речи. У большинства людей она расположена в левом полушарии.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L54 explicitly provides both production of language and speech-movement control, plus location on left side in the vast majority. Russian “у большинства” is a cautious subset of that qualifier. L79–L83 caution language is distributed, so the text states an association and usual location, not a monopoly of all language in left Broca. Two sentences name the correct function and explain motor component/location.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Мозжечок сравнивает двигательные команды с обратной связью от мышц и суставов, включая ощущения равновесия.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L119–L121 describe a copy of motor commands compared in cerebellum against sensory feedback from muscles/joints, proprioceptive movement information and balance sensations, then corrective output. The note’s concise comparison of commands/feedback including balance is supported; it neither assigns this to Broca nor claims muscles/joints are the sole source of balance information.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В задней части веретенообразной извилины есть участок коры, избирательно реагирующий на лица.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The personally read complete PMC HTML contains the whole abstract L112–L114: primary fMRI study identifies a small face-selective area in HUMAN POSTERIOR FUSIFORM gyrus. Note preserves posterior localisation, selective response and absence of exclusivity. It does not infer that all recognition occurs in one spot or import unexamined PDF results.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Область Брока связана с контролем движений, необходимых для речи.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L54 directly states Broca controls movements responsible for speech. This adds the motor-control component to the broad output function “продуцирование речи”: the note specifies what Broca controls, not simply repeats that speech is produced. It is an own-Broca fact and may also occur in explanation.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Затылочные области 17 и 18 отвечают за первичное зрительное восприятие; зрительная информация обрабатывается и в височной и теменной долях.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L48 explicitly puts Brodmann areas17/18 in occipital lobe for primary visual perception and also temporal/parietal processing. The note includes both the primary-location clause and distributed-processing qualifier, so it does not reduce all vision to occipital cortex.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: С какой функцией прежде всего связывают область Брока в доминантном полушарии мозга?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Мозжечок сравнивает двигательные команды с обратной связью от мышц и суставов, включая ощущения равновесия.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «С какой функцией…? — Регуляцией равновесия» uses correct instrumental form, consistent with all alternatives; note has a clear cerebellum subject.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Balance regulation is a genuine neural function and plausible brain-region confusion, not an absurd category.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L54 singles out Broca speech/language output; L116–L121 place balance-feedback comparison in cerebellum. A Broca speech-motor role does not make whole-body balance its primary function.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Note teaches this wrong option’s actual cerebellar mechanism: motor command copy versus peripheral feedback/balance and correction, L119–L121. It is useful to balance itself rather than a generic unrelated brain fact.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: С какой функцией прежде всего связывают область Брока в доминантном полушарии мозга?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: В задней части веретенообразной извилины есть участок коры, избирательно реагирующий на лица.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Распознаванием лиц» completes the instrumental function question and note’s fusiform anatomical wording is grammatical.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Face recognition is another real higher cortical function, comparable to speech production and visual processing, giving a plausible cortical-location confusion.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: Broca’s primary stated relation at L54 is speech/language production. PMC primary abstract L112–L114 identifies face-selective posterior fusiform cortex; it does not make face recognition Broca’s primary role.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note’s posterior fusiform selective-response observation is exactly the primary study’s abstract result. It supplies a concrete own-face-function locator without pretending to have read the PDF or claiming exclusive recognition anatomy.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: С какой функцией прежде всего связывают область Брока в доминантном полушарии мозга?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Область Брока связана с контролем движений, необходимых для речи.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Продуцированием речи» is a correct instrumental answer and uses the same grammatical form/detail level as distractors.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: This standard neuroanatomical association must be recalled; the alternatives are all actual neural functions and do not reveal it by syntax or length.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L54 directly links Broca with language production/speech movements. “Прежде всего” avoids excluding distributed support, and dominant-hemisphere wording is consistent with L79–L83 predominant-language lateralisation without assuming left for every person. Unique key2 is independently supported.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note identifies Broca’s motor-control contribution—control of movements needed for speech—beyond naming the high-level output function. This is meaningful functional specificity rather than an unrelated localisation fact; L54 directly supplies it.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: С какой функцией прежде всего связывают область Брока в доминантном полушарии мозга?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Затылочные области 17 и 18 отвечают за первичное зрительное восприятие; зрительная информация обрабатывается и в височной и теменной долях.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Обработкой зрительной информации» is grammatically parallel to other instrumental function labels. Both clauses of the note are coherent.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Visual processing is a real cortical function and processing of faces is a related but distinct alternative, so the offered labels remain thematically plausible.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: L48 puts primary visual perception in occipital17/18 with temporal/parietal processing; L54 assigns Broca speech output. General visual processing is not Broca’s primary function in this comparison.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note usefully gives the precise visual cortical areas and the additional temporal/parietal processing qualifier from L48. It does not overclaim a single visual centre.

absoluteLevel.individualGround: Knowing the named Broca region’s principal role requires familiarity with human neuroanatomy. General adults may know speech is a brain function but cannot distinguish Broca from sensory/recognition/balance systems just from the prompt. This is a standard thematic association rather than a rare lesion, cytoarchitectonic number or specialist diagnostic detail. Four plausible neural functions support MEDIUM.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Broca area is associated with control of movements necessary for speech.
correctNoteExtraFact.beyondPromptAndKey: The question/key name a high-level output function, producing speech. The note adds the motor-control implementation component—movements needed to realise speech—rather than merely saying Broca produces speech. It is about the same region/function and is directly stated in primaryL54; overlap with explanation is allowed.
